name: Temple The First
overview: The Scriptures reveal God's directive to King David regarding the building of a permanent house for the Ark of God, emphasizing that God had not dwelt in a house since the Exodus but rather in tents and tabernacles. God reminded David that despite His presence with Israel and His guidance over the tribes, He had not commanded a house of cedar until this time. This underscores the significance of establishing a dedicated temple as a dwelling place for God among His people, marking a pivotal moment in Israel's worship and God's covenantal relationship with David.
